teaser.en: Its Digo name means roughly 'the one that bends towards the sea', and on the coral shore it leans just that way.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana ya takriban 'unaoinamia bahari', na katika ufuo wa matumbawe huinama hivyo hasa.
teaser.dg: Manage ga dzinare ra Chidigo ni dza 'unaoinamira bahari', na pwani ya mawe ga sanoo unadeguka dza ivyo hasa.

summary.en: *Muinamia bahari* is a small, gnarled shrub of rocky coral shores with tiny grey-green leaves and some of the hardest wood on the coast. It lives where few plants can, on bare coral rock lashed by salt spray.
summary.sw: *Muinamia bahari* ni kichaka kidogo kilichopindika-pindika cha fukwe za miamba ya matumbawe, chenye majani madogo sana ya kijivu-kijani na mojawapo ya mbao ngumu zaidi pwani. Huishi mahali ambapo mimea michache huweza kuishi, juu ya miamba mitupu ya matumbawe inayopigwa na manyunyu ya chumvi.
summary.dg: *Muinamia bahari* ni chitsaka chidide chirichobeta cha pwani za mawe ga sanoo, chenye makodza madide sana ga rangi ya ivu na chijani, na mbao ziri kahi ya mbao ngumu zaidi za pwani. Unamera phatu mimea michache inaphoweza kumera, dzulu ya mawe ga sanoo gasigo na chitu, ganayopigbwa ni munyu wa madzi ga bahari.

about.en:
*Muinamia bahari* is a small shrub, sometimes a little tree, with twisted, knotted stems and very hard wood. Its leaves are tiny, narrow and grey-green, crowded along the twigs, and slightly fleshy, which helps the plant hold water in a salty, sun-baked place. Small white flowers with crinkled petals appear among the leaves.

On exposed shores the wind and spray prune it into low, dense cushions and leaning shapes, so it often looks older than it is.
about.sw:
*Muinamia bahari* ni kichaka kidogo, wakati mwingine mti mdogo, chenye mashina yaliyosokotana na yenye mafundo, na mbao ngumu sana. Majani yake ni madogo sana, membamba na ya kijivu-kijani, yamesongamana kando ya vitawi, na yana unyama kidogo, jambo linalousaidia mmea kuhifadhi maji mahali penye chumvi na jua kali. Maua madogo meupe yenye petali zilizokunjamana huchanua kati ya majani.

Katika fukwe zilizo wazi, upepo na manyunyu huupogoa kuwa na maumbo mafupi yaliyosongamana kama mito na maumbo yanayoinama, hivyo mara nyingi huonekana mkongwe kuliko ulivyo.
about.dg:
*Muinamia bahari* ni chitsaka chidide, wakati wanjina muhi mdide, chenye mihi iriyobeta na yenye mafundo, na mbao ngumu sana. Makodzage ni madide sana, membamba na ga rangi ya ivu na chijani, ganamera phamwenga dzulu ya maphungo, na ni ga madzi-madzi chidide, chitu chinachouterya mmea kuika madzi phatu pha munyu na dzuwa kali. Maruwa madide ga rangi nyereru, genye vipande vyenye makunyanzi, ganatuluka kahi ya makodza.

Pwani za weru, phepho na munyu wa bahari vinauhenda ukale mfupi, wa mafungu ganayogbwirana, na unadeguka, kpwa hivyo kpwa kawaida unaonekana wa kare kuriko urivyo.

where.en: It grows on coral-rock shores and on the landward fringes of the mangroves, rooting in cracks in the rock just above the reach of ordinary tides. Look for it on the old coral platforms along the south coast, where it forms grey-green clumps between the rock pools and the bush behind.
where.sw: Huota katika fukwe za miamba ya matumbawe na kwenye kingo za mikoko upande wa nchi kavu, ukitia mizizi katika nyufa za mwamba juu kidogo ya kufikiwa na maji ya kawaida. Utaupata kwenye majukwaa ya zamani ya matumbawe kando ya pwani ya kusini, ambapo huunda makundi ya kijivu-kijani kati ya vidimbwi vya miambani na vichaka vilivyo nyuma.
where.dg: Unamera pwani za mawe ga sanoo na kanda ya bara ya mikoko, uchimera kahi ya myanya ya mawe, dzulu chidide ya phatu madzi ga kuodzala ga kawaida ganaphofika. Uhendze dzulu ya mawe ga sanoo ga kare pwani ya kusini, ambapho unahenda mafungu ga rangi ya ivu na chijani kahi ya madimbwi ga madzi ga bahari na weruni nyuma.

uses.en: No particular uses have been recorded among the Digo so far, though its wood is known around the Indian Ocean as exceptionally hard and dense.
uses.sw: Hadi sasa hakuna matumizi maalumu yaliyorekodiwa miongoni mwa Wadigo, ingawa mbao zake zinajulikana kuzunguka Bahari ya Hindi kuwa ngumu na nzito kupita kiasi.
uses.dg: Hadi sambi takuna kazi iriyoandikpwa ya chitsaka chichi kahi ya Adigo, ela mbaoze zinamanyikana kanda-kanda ya Bahari ya Hindi kukala ni ngumu na ndziho sana.

culture.en: The name *muinamia bahari* means roughly 'the one that bends towards the sea', a good description of a shrub that leans out over the shore.
culture.sw: Jina *muinamia bahari* lina maana ya takriban 'unaoinamia bahari', maelezo mazuri ya kichaka kinachoinama juu ya ufuo.
culture.dg: Dzina *muinamia bahari* manage ni dza 'unaoinamira bahari', na rinaeleza vinono chitsaka chinachodeguka dzulu ya pwani.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *muinamia bahari*. No Swahili name has been recorded, though the related Swahili name *mwinamia maji* is given for seablite, another shrub of the salty shore. In English it is pemphis, and its scientific name is *Pemphis acidula*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *muinamia bahari*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa, ingawa jina la Kiswahili linalofanana nalo, *mwinamia maji*, hutolewa kwa mwinyonye (*seablite*), kichaka kingine cha ufuo wenye chumvi. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *pemphis*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Pemphis acidula*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *muinamia bahari*. Dzina ra Chiswahili taridzangbweandikpwa, ela dzina ra Chiswahili rinalohalana nare, *mwinamia maji*, nkuhumirwa kpwa *seablite*, chitsaka chanjina cha pwani yenye munyu. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *pemphis*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Pemphis acidula*.

reason.dg: Chitsaka chanjina cha pwani chinachovumirira munyu, chenye dzina ra Chiswahili rinalohalana
